text: Menen Meɗen anndi wonnde sirkooɓe ɓen hino wi'a wonnde: Muhammadu jom-kisyee on, ko neɗɗanke woni mo anndinnde Alqur'aana. Awa ɓe fenu ɗum, tawde ɗemngal ngal ɓe aaƴotoo ngal ko ajami, ndee Alqur'aanaare non, ko e ɗemngal Aarabu ɓanngungal jogingal fasinteegal toowngal nde jippori . Ko honno ɓe aaƴorta wonnde ko e ajamiyankeejo o anndiri nde?
